text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "Search moved from Postgres full-text search to SQLite FTS5 by 1 Jul; the Postgres implementation is no longer in place."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "refines", "reason": "The database is SQLite, and this adds the detail that its FTS5 extension handles full-text search."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "Postgres full-text search is no longer used at all as of 1 Jul, so the judgement that it suffices no longer holds."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus's sign-off on SQLite happened and stays true; the FTS5 detail does not change it."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Which search engine is used says nothing about whether the schema is settled; both can be true."}]}
